description: Aura Phase-J = masterplan Phase 6 (Tool Experience Loop) — Alternative A (storage-first), MCP-aware. Full spec in docs/phase06-plan-alt-A-storage-first-2026-05-15.md including §9 MCP considerations. Goal per PRD §6: 'Aura improves from preventable tool-call failures instead of repeating them.' Approach: typed `tool_attempts` SQLite table is the synchronous source of truth; every ToolObservation writes synchronously; pre-LLM briefer + per-(tool,class) retry budget + /api/tool-warnings operator channel all read from it. Deferred to Phase-K (orthogonal milestone — transaction boundaries): durable workflow execution, idempotency keys, reconcile-first for side_effect_unknown, lesson promotion. MCP-specific invariants in every story: tool_name has NO FK (servers come/go), tool_kind column derived from `mcp_*` prefix, briefer handles offline-server history gracefully, retry budget is outer-loop only (MCP server internal retries invisible). Each story = ONE atomic commit on master.

userStories.title: ToolObservation contract + 10->5 bucket classifier
userStories.description: Add internal/agent/tools/registry/observation.go with the canonical 5-bucket Outcome contract from PRD §6 Phase 6. (a) `type Outcome uint8` with constants `OutcomeOK`, `OutcomeRecoverable`, `OutcomeBlocked`, `OutcomeFatal`, `OutcomeCancelled`. (b) `BucketOf(class string) Outcome` mapping the 10 labels in internal/agent/tools/registry/error.go:13-41 -> 5 buckets per the spec in docs/phase06-plan-alt-A-storage-first-2026-05-15.md §2 US-J01: recoverable={validation, not_found, rate_limited, io}; blocked={permission, blocked}; fatal={error, timeout}; cancelled={cancelled}; empty=ok. (c) `type ToolObservation struct { RunID, ToolName string; ToolKind string; // 'native' or 'mcp' derived from `mcp_` prefix at construction; AttemptN uint16; Outcome Outcome; Class string; Reason string; ArgsHash [32]byte; ArgKeys []string; SchemaHash [16]byte; ErrorRedacted string; StartedAt time.Time; ElapsedMS int64 }`. (d) Plumb ToolObservation through internal/agent/executor.go::executeOneTool (the error path at executor.go around lines 123-151): every tool result, success or failure, produces an Observation. (e) Tests: all 10 -> 5 mappings verified; tool_kind='mcp' when name starts with 'mcp_' (cite: internal/agent/tools/registry/mcp.go:26-27 for the prefix convention); empty Class -> OutcomeOK; struct round-trips through encoding/gob for downstream persistence in US-J02. NO downstream consumer in this story.

userStories.title: Migration v10 tool_attempts + synchronous Repo.Record
userStories.description: Land the persistence foundation. (a) Migration v10 'add_tool_attempts' in internal/db/migrations/migrations.go (append to registered list, follow the addSecretsTable v9 pattern). Schema EXACTLY as docs/phase06-plan-alt-A-storage-first-2026-05-15.md §3: `tool_attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id, tool_call_id, attempt_n INTEGER, tool_name, tool_kind, tool_schema_hash, outcome, class, reason, args_hash, arg_keys_json, error_redacted, elapsed_ms INTEGER, started_at, ended_at TEXT)` with NO FK on tool_name (MCP servers come/go) but FK on run_id -> runs(id). Four indexes: idx_tool_attempts_run_tool, idx_tool_attempts_tool_outcome, idx_tool_attempts_run_outcome, idx_tool_attempts_signature. Plus a `tool_warnings` SQL view as in the plan §3. (b) New package internal/agent/tools/attempts/ with: Repo interface (Record + Recent), SQLiteRepo implementation using BEGIN IMMEDIATE for atomic writes, SHA-256 hashing for args (sorted-keys canonical JSON). NO raw secret values stored. ErrRepoUnavailable typed sentinel when DB is nil. (c) Args canonicalisation: a small `canonicalArgsJSON(map[string]any) []byte` helper that sorts keys recursively before marshalling - required for stable args_hash across LLM re-orderings. (d) Tests: migration on fresh DB + on v9 DB; Record roundtrip with verification that args values are NEVER in the row (only hash + key names); concurrent Record from 4 goroutines yields 4 distinct rows; Recent returns newest-first ordered; mcp-named tools get tool_kind='mcp' via the upstream observation. No consumer wired yet - that's US-J03.

userStories.title: Wire Repo.Record into the executor hot path
userStories.description: Connect US-J01 (observation emission) + US-J02 (persistence) so every tool call lands in tool_attempts. (a) Modify internal/agent/executor.go: agentExecutor struct gains a `repo attempts.Repo` field; constructor takes the repo (or nil - Repo is optional, see e below). (b) executeOneTool emits a ToolObservation at the end of every code path (success at ~line 116, error at ~lines 140-149) and calls `e.repo.Record(ctx, obs)` synchronously BEFORE returning. (c) On Record error, log via slog.Error('tool_attempts_write_failed', 'err', err, 'tool_name', obs.ToolName) but DO NOT propagate to the caller - the tool result must still reach the user. The briefer (US-J04) treats missing rows as 'no signal', so a write failure degrades gracefully. (d) ExecuteToolCalls (around lines 65-121) doesn't need changes - the per-call observation happens inside executeOneTool. (e) When e.repo is nil (test path or feature flag off), the executor skips Record silently - same idiom as the existing nil-LLM check. (f) cmd/aura/app.go wires the repo: construct attempts.NewSQLiteRepo(a.deps.Pool) and pass into the executor factory. (g) Tests: a real-executor integration test that runs a fake tool returning an error, then asserts a row exists in tool_attempts with the right Outcome+Class. Use the existing executor test scaffolding (internal/agent/executor_test.go).

userStories.title: Pre-LLM tool-experience briefer (governance hook)
userStories.description: PRD §6: 'retrieve validated lessons for similar future tool calls'. Insert a pre-LLM context capsule before every LLM round summarising recent failures of the tools currently in the per-turn pool. (a) New file internal/agent/tools/attempts/briefer.go with `Briefer struct { repo Repo; logger *slog.Logger }` and `Brief(ctx, threadID string, toolNames []string, availableSet map[string]struct{}) string`. (b) For each tool in the pool, call `repo.Recent(ctx, threadID, toolName, 3)`. Filter to outcomes in {recoverable, blocked, fatal}. Format as a single synthetic system-side capsule: 'Recent tool experience for this thread:\n- web_fetch: 2x validation (last: redirect loop)\n- mcp_github_search: 1x rate_limited (last 30 min ago, currently unavailable)'. (c) Caps: <=200 chars per tool, <=8 tools surfaced, total capsule <=1500 chars. Empty result -> return empty string (no noise injection). (d) MCP awareness: when toolName starts with 'mcp_' and the tool is NOT in availableSet at call time (MCP server offline), append '(currently unavailable)' to the line. (e) Wire into internal/agent/loop.go just BEFORE the client.Chat call (around line 287 where messagesForModel is built). The capsule is prepended to messagesForModel as a synthetic system message. NEVER mutates state.Messages(); the capsule lives one turn. (f) Tests: empty repo -> no capsule; 3 tools with prior failures -> 3-line capsule; 12 tools -> only top 8 by recency; mcp tool offline (not in availableSet) -> '(currently unavailable)' annotation; cap test verifying total length stays <=1500 chars.

userStories.title: Per-(tool, error-class) retry budget enforced via tool_attempts count
userStories.description: PRD §6: 'cap retries by run, tool, and error kind, and record why a retry was attempted or refused.' (a) Add to internal/agent/loop.go Options: `RetryBudgets map[Outcome]int` with default {OutcomeRecoverable: 2, OutcomeBlocked: 0, OutcomeFatal: 0, OutcomeCancelled: 0}. (b) New helper internal/agent/tools/attempts/budget.go: `CheckBudget(ctx, repo, runID, toolName string, outcome Outcome, budget int) (allowed bool, reason string)`. Implementation: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_attempts WHERE run_id=? AND tool_name=? AND outcome=?`; if count >= budget, return false + 'retry_budget_exhausted_for_class:<outcome>'. (c) Wire into the BeforeTool hook in loop.go: when an executor returns a recoverable error, check the budget BEFORE the next dispatch of the same (tool, class). If exhausted, divert to the duplicate-call stub path (`Error: retry budget exhausted for class X`) and persist a refusal row via repo.Record with outcome=blocked + reason='retry_budget_exhausted_for_class:recoverable'. (d) MCP awareness: the budget is outer-loop only - MCP server internal retries are invisible. AttemptN counts only Aura-side dispatches. Document this in a comment on RetryBudgets. (e) Tests: budget=2 + 3 recoverable errors -> 3rd refused with structured reason logged; budget=0 + 1 blocked error -> refused immediately; budget=2 + 2 recoverable + 1 success after -> success persisted, no refusal; refusal row has outcome=blocked + class=original_class + reason=retry_budget_exhausted_for_class:X.

userStories.title: GET /api/tool-warnings operator channel
userStories.description: PRD §6 gate: 'repeat failures are visible by tool and error kind'. Add the operator-facing aggregation endpoint. (a) New file internal/api/tool_warnings.go with `handleToolWarnings(deps Deps) http.HandlerFunc`. (b) Reads `SELECT tool_name, tool_kind, class, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(ended_at) AS last_seen FROM tool_attempts WHERE outcome IN ('recoverable','blocked','fatal') AND ended_at >= datetime('now','-7 days') GROUP BY tool_name, tool_kind, class ORDER BY n DESC`. (c) Response shape: `{ "warnings": [{ "kind": "native"|"mcp", "tool": "...", "class": "...", "n": int, "last_seen": "RFC3339" }, ...] }`. (d) Admin-gated via deps.SkillsAdmin (same gate as skills install/delete - consistent with existing /api admin convention). (e) Wire in internal/api/router.go alongside the other dashboard endpoints. (f) Tests: 5 mixed failures across 2 tools -> 2-row response sorted by n DESC; mcp_X_search and web_fetch both present -> both kinds in response; admin gate off -> 403; empty repo -> empty warnings array (NOT 404).
